title: Sprint spillover lift and contact ledger
content:
Sheet view: sprint_spillover_snapshot
Columns: Owner, Function, Contact (email), Backup owner, Estimated spillover hrs, Critical blocker?, Jira refs, Next follow-up, Current status, Quick note

Rows:
Aisha Kapoor, Platform Ops, aisha@redwood.ai, Daniel Reed, 6, No, PLAT-2345;OPS-998, 2029-09-13, Actionable, "Reassign infra q2 test to Daniel; Aisha will close when infra runs green"
Daniel Reed, SRE, daniel@redwood.ai, Marcus Wu, 12, Yes, SRE-401, 2029-09-14, Needs info, "Waiting on capacity numbers from infra team; blocking canary rollout"
Lina Gomez, Product-ops, lina@redwood.ai, Priya Nair, 4, No, PROD-88, 2029-09-15, In progress, "Customer handoff docs missing; Lina drafting checklist"
Marcus Wu, Serving-runtime, marcus@redwood.ai, Daniel Reed, 10, Yes, RUN-77;PLAT-2345, 2029-09-16, Stalled, "Memory regression investigation; cherry-pick queued but needs review"
Priya Nair, Solutions Eng, priya@redwood.ai, Lina Gomez, 3, No, SE-121, 2029-09-13, Done, "Provided workaround to pilot customer; will remove once PR merged"

Summary notes:
- Snapshot taken after sprint demo; small number of tasks spilled (avg 7 hrs).
- Two hotspots: Daniel (12h) and Marcus (10h) both have "Critical blocker?" flagged — high priority to clear before Friday.
- Quick reassign proposal: move one infra test from Daniel -> Aisha to free up 4h for Daniel to unblock canary. Marked in row Aisha.

Quick pivots / mini-analysis:
- Total estimated spillover hours: 35.
- Count critical-blockers: 2/5 owners.
- Top contributors to spill: SRE & Serving-runtime (combined 22h).

Recommended immediate actions (short checklist):
- [ ] Aisha to confirm reassign by 09/13 EOD (slack thread linked).
- [ ] Marcus to post minimal repro + mem profile by 09/13 morning.
- [ ] Daniel to request capacity snapshot from infra (ticket PLAT-2345 comment) and cc oncall.
- [ ] Lina to finish customer handoff doc draft and add checklist to Confluence (link placeholder).

Notes to self / loose ideas:
- Could build a small automation to flag owners with >8h spill and critical=true and auto-schedule a 15m unblock sync. (MVP: Google Calendar + Slack bot)
- Consider creating a weekly micro-coverage rota for spikes (2 engineers tagged as backup each day).

Open questions / risks:
- Does Dedicated capacity pool have available burst for canary? (linked to PLAT-2345)
- Is memory regression reproducible on smaller test harness? if not, risk of extended debugging window.

Follow-ups (owners and dates):
- Aisha: confirm reassignment (2029-09-13)
- Marcus: attach mem profile + repro gist (2029-09-13)
- Daniel: update PLAT-2345 with infra snapshot + tentative plan (2029-09-14)
- Lina: Confluence checklist + customer email (2029-09-15)

Micro-communication snippets (copy/paste):
- To SRE on slack: "Heads-up: spike on canary rollout — Daniel needs 4h. Aisha offered to take infra test; can you ack? PLAT-2345"
- To customer pilot: "We hit a small regression during final canary. We have a workaround and estimate <48h to close. We'll keep you posted. Lina will follow up."

Versioning / history:
- 2029-09-10: initial capture post-demo (Aisha)
- 2029-09-11: updated with Marcus repro note (Marcus)
- 2029-09-12: finalized quick reassign and action list (Aisha)

Quick metadata for ops intake:
- Urgency: high (two critical blockers)
- Expected burn to close: ~18 hours of focused triage across owners
- Customer impact: medium (delayed canary + pilot email required)

End of ledger.
